body:
perf-bot: nightly-run: decode p95 +18% on release branch (gpu-bench). dashboard: https://perf.redwood/d/bench/2026-03-18 :eyes:
Alex Chen: saw the spike this morning. it lines up with the matmul selector change merged in PR #3421.
Maria Gupta: i pulled a trace. looks like matmul-v2 is being chosen for small attention matmuls and it's splitting the op into two kernels + an extra memcpy.
Jia Li: repro'd locally by forcing selector=matmul-v2. p95 jumps ~17% on short-seq workloads. forcing legacy returns perf to baseline.
Sam Ortiz: that matches the nightly CI failure note. release job flagged "decode-regression" and flagged rollout blockers.
Leo Park: can we push a hotfix toggle? a runtime flag would be quick but we need a safe deploy window. ops-bot, any constraints?
ops-bot: rollout-safety: blocked - must resolve regression alerts before continuing canary.
Maria Gupta: profiler snippet (nvtx stack-ish):
```
Event: matmul_v2_kernel_launch
  time: 12.4ms
  memcpy H2D: 1.8ms
  matmul chunk 1: 5.1ms
  matmul chunk 2: 4.6ms
  overhead (launchs): 0.9ms
```
Maria Gupta: compare to legacy matmul:
```
Event: matmul_legacy
  time: 9.1ms
  single kernel launch
  no extra memcpy
```
Alex Chen: the selector heuristics changed to prefer matmul-v2 for shapes >= 32x32; looks like attention kv shapes often hit the new threshold unexpectedly (sequence len x head dim combos). edgecase: short sequences with wide heads.
Jia Li: i ran a quick flamegraph. extra kernel launches show up as thin vertical lines across many tokens - KV cache warm paths get amortized poorly.
Sam Ortiz: options: 1) revert the selector change (clean but heavier process), 2) add runtime override to prefer legacy for small-ish shapes, 3) tweak threshold and release a patch.
Leo Park: +1 to targetted revert for safety. we can later reintroduce after adding a test for shape thresholds.
Alex Chen: i started a branch that pins the selector to legacy for shapes <= 128*64 (branch: fix/matmul-selector-rollback). will push benches.
Maria Gupta: please add a unit test that simulates attention matmul shapes (seq 8-64, head 64-256) so this doesn't regress again.
Sam Ortiz: i'll open a revert PR referencing commit abcdef1 and include microbench numbers and profiler traces. tagging @release for approvals.
release-bot: revert PR template ready - ensure changelog entry and benchmark artifacts attached.
Jia Li: uploading traces + nvprof capture: https://artifacts.redwood/reports/3809991234/matmul-trace.zip
Alex Chen: reproduction steps for devs:
```bash
# reproduce local perf regression
git checkout release/2026-03-18
# build runtime with selector override
RUNTIME_SELECTOR=matmul-v2 ./tools/bench --model tiny-attn --seq 16 --heads 8 --batch 4
# force legacy to compare
RUNTIME_SELECTOR=matmul-legacy ./tools/bench --model tiny-attn --seq 16 --heads 8 --batch 4
```
Sam Ortiz: i'll open the PR now, cc @Maria Gupta for perf artifacts, @Leo Park for deploy window.
Leo Park: once PR is up, i'll request emergency deploy for the hotfix window tomorrow 02:00 UTC.
Alex Chen: action items: Sam -> open revert PR + attach artifacts; Maria/Jia -> add tests and perf traces; Leo -> schedule deploy; Ops -> unblock rollout after merge.
Sam Ortiz: on it. thanks all :thumbsup:
